title: Modules
explain: A Go module is a folder with a `go.mod` file that names it and records its dependencies. Create one with `go mod init`, then run the package in the current folder with `go run .`. `go mod tidy` adds what you import and removes what you don't.
code:
mkdir hello && cd hello
go mod init example.com/hello     # creates go.mod
cat > main.go <<'EOF'
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello, module") }
EOF
go run .          # build and run
go mod tidy       # sync dependencies
exercise: Create a new module, make it print your name, and run it with `go run .`.
tip: Run Go commands from the folder that contains `go.mod`. Elsewhere you get a "go.mod file not found" error.
